criteria_details.description: States that the patient's rash is painless
Notes that the location of the patient's rash is characteristic of syphilis
States syphilis is the most probable diagnosis.
States that a rash is the most characteristic finding of secondary syphilis
States the initial diagnostic test for secondary syphilis is a nontreponemal test.
States that rapid plasma reagin (RPR) is a type of nontreponemal test.
States that Venereal Disease Research Laboratory (VDRL) is a type of nontreponemal test.
States that Toluidine Red Unheated Serum Test (TRUST) is a type of nontreponemal test.
States the test to confirm the diagnosis of syphilis is a treponemal test.
States that Fluorescent treponemal antibody absorption (FTA-ABS) is a type of treponemal test.
States that Microhemagglutination test for antibodies to T. pallidum (MHA-TP) is a type of treponemal test.
States that T. pallidum particle agglutination assay (TPPA) is a type of treponemal test.
States that T. pallidum enzyme immunoassay (TP-EIA) is a type of treponemal test.
States that Chemiluminescence immunoassay (CIA) is a type of treponemal test.
States that syphilis is a sexually transmitted infection.
Recommends treatment of secondary syphilis with antibiotics.
Recommends the patient be screened for other sexually transmitted infections.
Recommends safe sex practices to prevent transmission of sexually transmitted infections.
Recommends informing all sexual partners within the past 6 months of the diagnosis of syphilis.
